title: Law to require standard designs for small city buildings
summary: This bill would require the Department of Design and Construction to create and maintain a catalog of pre-approved standard designs for small city-owned structures, such as public restrooms and storage buildings, that cost no more than $10 million and cover no more than 2,500 square feet. City agencies would have to require bidders to use a design from this catalog unless it cannot reasonably fit the project site. The law would take effect one year after passage.
